MARKET VENDOR AT STALL — pixel-NPC vendor in a striped apron calling out cheerfully at a wooden stall stacked with wicker baskets of red apples and golden pears, colorful price-tags dangling from the awning, two customers leaning in to browse, cobblestone square bustling around him.

FISHMONGER SORTING CATCH — pixel-NPC fishmonger in a rubber apron sorting glistening fish onto a wooden table at a harbor-side stall, baskets of catch stacked beside her, a seagull eyeing the goods overhead, customer with a cloth bag approaching from the left.

HERBALIST ARRANGING DRIED HERBS — pixel-NPC herbalist with silver-streaked hair tying bundles of dried lavender and rosemary to the awning-poles of her cottage shopfront, rows of labeled jars on the shelf behind her, mortar-and-pestle on the counter, customer pausing to sniff a hanging bundle.

BAKER PULLING BREAD FROM OVEN — pixel-NPC baker in a flour-dusted apron drawing golden loaves from a stone oven with a long wooden peel, smoke curling from the open oven mouth, fresh loaves stacked on a cooling rack, warm amber light spilling from the bakery doorway.

CHILDREN CHASING BALL — three pixel-NPC children sprinting across sun-dappled cobblestone chasing a worn leather ball, arms pumping, mouths open in laughter-implied motion, a small spotted dog bounding alongside them, a fruit vendor shaking his head with a grin as they pass his stall.

KIDS DRAWING ON COBBLESTONE — two pixel-NPC children kneeling on smooth cobblestone sketching a hopscotch grid in bright chalk, a basket of laundry set nearby suggesting their mother is close, a tabby cat sitting at the edge of the grid watching with idle curiosity.

CHILD CLIMBING TREE — pixel-NPC child hauling herself up the gnarled lower branches of a wide oak in the town square, a friend below with arms outstretched grinning up at her, scattered autumn leaves on the cobblestone, dappled light filtering through the canopy above.

CAT SLEEPING ON BARREL — fat orange tabby sprawled across the flat top of a wooden barrel outside a tavern door, one paw dangling lazily over the edge, sunlight pooling on its belly, a half-empty flower-box on the windowsill above framing the drowsy scene.

DOG NAPPING IN SHADE — large shaggy hound stretched out in the cool shadow of a market awning, tongue lolling sideways, one ear twitching at flies, a basket of warm bread loaves resting on the bench beside its sleeping owner, the square buzzing gently around them.

CHICKENS PECKING IN SQUARE — three rust-brown chickens pecking rapidly at scattered grain on the cobblestone of the market square, heads bobbing in quick pixel-motion, a tipped-over grain basket beside a vegetable stall, the stallkeeper waving a cloth at them half-heartedly without real urgency.

VILLAGER CARRYING VEGETABLE BASKET — pixel-NPC villager in a loose linen tunic walking briskly down a cobblestone lane, a wide wicker basket overflowing with fat orange carrots, leafy cabbages, and braided onions balanced on her hip, warm afternoon light casting long shadows behind her.

WOMAN HANGING LAUNDRY — pixel-NPC woman in a linen apron pinning damp shirts and linens to a rope line strung between two stone cottages, wooden clothespins clamped in her lips, a basket of wet washing at her feet, bright wildflowers blooming in the window-box beside her.

OLD MAN WHITTLING ON BENCH — pixel-NPC elderly villager in a patched brown cloak seated on a stone bench near the square, carving a small wooden bird with a whittling knife, pale wood-shavings curling at his boots, a clay pipe in the corner of his mouth, dog dozing at his side.

TRAVELER WITH PACK — pixel-NPC road-weary traveler in a dusty cloak and wide-brimmed hat arriving at the edge of the market square, large leather pack strapped to her back, pausing to consult a scrawled map, a local child pointing helpfully down a side lane.

BLACKSMITH HAMMERING ANVIL — pixel-NPC blacksmith in a scorched leather apron raising a heavy hammer above glowing orange metal on the anvil, sparks arcing through the forge-house air, the forge fire blazing red behind him, a young apprentice gripping the bellows handle with both hands.

POTTER AT WHEEL — pixel-NPC potter with clay-smeared hands shaping a tall vessel on a spinning wooden wheel under a canvas awning, finished pots of various sizes arranged on shelves behind her, a small kiln smoking quietly in the corner, afternoon light warm on the fresh clay.

WEAVER AT LOOM — pixel-NPC weaver seated at a broad wooden loom outside her cottage doorway, shuttle passing swiftly through colorful warp-threads, a growing length of patterned cloth visible on the beam, baskets of dyed yarn in amber, green, and red stacked neatly at her feet.

BAKER'S COOK STIRRING STEW — pixel-NPC cook in a stained apron stirring a wide iron cauldron suspended over a crackling outdoor fire behind the tavern, ladle in both hands, thick steam rising into the air, a row of chopped vegetables on the prep-board beside the fire, rich smell implied.

LANTERN-LIGHTER ON LADDER — pixel-NPC lantern-lighter in a cap and vest balanced on a short wooden ladder touching a long taper to a hanging iron street-lantern, twilight deepening across the lane, three lanterns already glowing amber behind him, warm light pooling softly on the cobblestones below.

STREET-SWEEPER AT DUSK — pixel-NPC street-sweeper in a patched cloak pushing a wide bristle broom along the cobblestone path, a small dust-cloud rising ahead of the brush, a tabby cat padding curiously behind him, lit cottage windows glowing orange on either side in the settling dusk.

TOWN CRIER WITH BELL — pixel-NPC town crier in a bright blue-and-gold tunic standing on the top step of the town-square platform ringing a bronze hand-bell vigorously, a rolled paper scroll tucked under his arm, a cluster of villagers pausing their errands to turn and listen with amused faces.

FOUNTAIN VILLAGERS DRAWING WATER — two pixel-NPC villagers at a mossy stone fountain filling round clay jugs from the spouting basin, a wicker shopping basket between them, three children wading and splashing in the shallow pool behind, sunlight scattering off the water in bright pixel-glint arcs.

BARD PLAYING LUTE — pixel-NPC bard in a patched green-and-gold jerkin seated on the worn tavern steps strumming a polished wooden lute, foot tapping the cobblestone, a small ring of villagers gathered around listening warmly, an upturned cap collecting coins on the ground in front of him.

SIGN-PAINTER ON LADDER — pixel-NPC sign-painter perched on a wooden ladder painting a fresh golden fox onto the hanging tavern sign, paint-pot hooked over a rung, a drip of ochre paint on the cobblestone below, the tavern-keeper watching from the doorway with arms folded and a pleased expression.

CARAVAN ARRIVING WITH GOODS — a wide wooden caravan-wagon drawn by a dun ox rolling into the market square at a slow plod, the merchant on the bench tipping his hat, crates and bulging canvas sacks piled high in the wagon-bed, two children running alongside, a dog barking happily at the wheels.

BAKER LOADING DELIVERY BASKET — pixel-NPC baker in a round cap loading fresh round loaves into a wide wicker basket at the bakery door, steam rising visibly from the warm bread, the lit bakery window glowing amber behind him, a town-cat winding hopefully around his boots.

COOK STIRRING STEW — pixel-NPC tavern cook in stained apron stirring a heavy iron cauldron over a crackling outdoor cooking fire, long ladle in both hands, thick aromatic steam billowing upward, baskets of potatoes and onions queued beside the fire, tavern sign creaking gently overhead.

VILLAGERS DRAWING WATER AT FOUNTAIN — two pixel-NPC villagers filling clay water-jugs at a mossy stone fountain in the square, a wicker basket resting nearby, two children splashing and laughing in the fountain basin behind them, sunlight fracturing in the thrown water-droplets, pigeons drinking at the edge.

KIDS SPLASHING IN FOUNTAIN — three pixel-NPC children in rolled-up trousers splashing through the town fountain basin, arms flung wide, water droplets catching the afternoon sun, a pile of discarded shoes on the cobblestone rim, an elderly woman on a nearby bench smiling and shaking her head fondly.

BARD PLAYING LUTE ON TAVERN STEPS — pixel-NPC bard in a worn colourful jerkin seated on the tavern steps playing a wooden lute, one foot tapping the rhythm, a small ring of villagers gathered close listening, a cloth cap with a few coins resting on the cobblestone before him, evening lanterns glowing warm.

MERCHANT CARAVAN ARRIVING — a wooden caravan-wagon pulled by a broad ox rolling into the market square, merchant on the driver's bench calling greetings, crates and canvas-wrapped bundles piled high behind, children running alongside the wagon in delight, a dog barking excitedly, stall-vendors leaning forward with interest, dust rising from the wheels.
